notes.title: UPDATE 1.23 - Polish and Bug Fixes!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33100820/9e177795e44f8705e54acd0641201e5ad70ce866.png[/img]

Hello Vektor Fish Blasters!

FAN'CIE VEER! just got another update, now well over 5 years since I launched it here on Steam!

Here's what's in this update:

- Fixed a bug where your ship could shrink to negative numbers at the "Level Complete" state of any level.  This could result in you not seeing your ship until you continued to the next level.  Not really a game breaking bug, but still something that looked silly none-the-less.  It's been resolved now.

- Fixed an extremely rare bug where your ship could get stuck inside a rock without exploding if you hit 3 rocks (vektoroids) at the same time at the right angle and speed.  Very rare situation for sure, but still it had to be fixed, and that is now resolved with this update.

- I completely re-drew the electric border walls that allow you to see when you have sufficient speed to crash though vektoroids.  (Remember, you have to have sufficient speed and also be the opposite color of the vektoroid to crash though it and get crash combo points)

- I re-colored and re-worked the 'Level Complete" screen to look better and also see how many total points you scored on that level which was never shown before this update.

- Changed the coloring of the blue vektor fish to show it as a truer blue making it easier to see that you need to change your ship to blue to blast it.


..That's about it for this update.  Small changes, but still important changes to me as an indie developer who cares about the small details of his games.  ..I hope that you enjoy this game with all of the changes and updates I've given to this game since I launched it back in July of 2018!  Let me know in the comments below!


Sincerely,

ZaxtorGameS ... (Solo Indie Game Developer)

notes.title: UPDATE 1.22 - A New Directional Arrow To Help Guide Your Paths!
notes.notes:
Hello gamers!

It's been a year now since the last update, and while that last update 1.21 was a great update and changed this game for good with all new mechanics, this update does just as much to help you control your ship!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33100820/1d471931b4040d95a91e20dd983929c3ec4af500.png[/img]

Now, by default, you'll see a white arrow in the background where-ever your mouse cursor is.  The arrow will point from your ships position to the arrows position to show you the exact direction you'll move when you hold down or press your left mouse button.  Remember that when you press your left mouse button to thrust, you'll always move towards your mouse position which is now indicated by the new arrow and your movement speed will always be faster the further away your mouse cursor is from your ship.  To help you see this visually, the arrow will now be a bigger size to show faster speeds and a smaller size to show slower movement speeds.

You can always turn this arrow off by pressing your space bar while your ship exists and turn it back on by pressing the space bar again.

It might sound pretty simple, but this is a MASSIVE Quality of Life change for this game!  I encourage to give it a try if you've ever found FAN'CIE VEER! a little frustrating to control!

Enemy Fish have been completely re-drawn to look angrier then ever!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33100820/ce7d2e575a761661f4adf5188c1c467d4a280b6f.jpg[/img]


Also in the update, I made a new "spawn" cursor to help you see where your ship will spawn before you press the space bar to spawn a new ship.  ..Another Q.O.L. (Quality of Life) change that I think helps just make this game more enjoyable overall.


Nothing else has been changed.  Just a couple of pretty snazzy Q.o.L. changes!


Enjoy!  =)


ZaxtorGameS ... (Solo Indie Game Developer)

notes.title: UPDATE 1.21 - "This Changes Everything!"
notes.notes:
Space blaster games all seem to need a way to keep the player from simply perching in one spot, moving a little only if needed, and firing away at asteroids and enemies without a second thought!

... I tried and tried since the launch of this game to convince players that crashing your ship through the vektoroids (rocks) was the best way to have both fun and the best way to score the most points.

...And despite my efforts, people still camped in one spot and fired away at all the rocks to clear levels caring nothing reaping the rewards (and fun) of taking risks!

AND FINALLY.. UPDATE 1.21 CHANGES EVERYTHING!  ..FINALLY PLAYERS WILL BE BE REQUIRED TO 
LEARN HOW TO PLAY 'FANCIE VEER' THE WAY IT WAS ORIGINALLY INTENDED TO BE PLAYED!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33100820/aa4b3832b12a2971db4e2cfdf11405084d9bb4d1.png[/img]


Now, you likely won't even survive the first level if you try to camp in a safe spot and fire away!  =)


Yes, it will take a little practice to get good at controlling your ship!  Remember that you use right mouse to move towards your mouse cursor and the speed your ship moves is based on how far the cursor is away from your ship!  ..Wanna slow down?  Simply right click while putting your mouse cursor close to your ship!  Ahh, see.. that ain't so bad!  ..You got this!   I assure you that it's MUCH more rewarding to clear levels the way this game was designed (crashing though them) than your lazy old school way of camping in a safe spot to clear out the rocks)


----- YOU CAN ALSO RE-MAP THE COLOR CHANGING KEYS IN THIS BUILD -----

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33100820/a0fa9ede8ebea8946d31e896c65a48a553fd2d50.png[/img]
Simply click the "Change Color Controls" button here on the home screen

and then click the key you want to change for each ship color as seen here
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33100820/1e0a15c0cd30cfd652d2beca818f7c5f4d023147.png[/img]


----- THE NUMBER OF VEKTOROIDS REMAINING CAN ALWAYS BE SEEN NOW -----

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33100820/2bbe6a2630c805119e6a26d5802ae55eb7c25c91.jpg[/img]


* FAN'CIE VEER has also been optimized heavily in this build.  Over 6,000 lines of code and calculations per second have been relieved of your CPU having to read and I believe that this makes the game play and feel better than ever before!

Remember to have fun!!  ..Oh and watch out for that Vektor fish!  ..he looks like he's kinda onto you!  =)


NOTES:   A critical extra life bug was fixed in this update (thanks MBCcompany) and I also updates the existing 24 Steam achievements as well as added 23 new ones  for a total of 47 now! 


Sincerely, 

ZaxtorGameS  (Solo Indie Game Developer)

notes.title: UPDATE 1.20 - MASSIVE UPDATE! - Crash Combo Scoring, Extra Life Changes & More!
notes.notes:
This is easily the biggest update to FAN'CIE VEER! since I launched it four years ago, back in July of 2018!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33100820/f8df736b41850fc824693d330c07597515f23824.png[/img]

Here are the changes made in this update:

- The scoring has completely been reworked to now reward much more based on your current crash combo stream regardless of what level you're on.  Your level still plays a part in your crash combo scoring but most of the weight is on how well you're doing crashing through rocks.

- I've added a counter in the background to show you how many seconds you have to crash through your next vektoroid to keep your crash combo streak alive.  This is extremely helpful, and definitely help adds excitement and pressure as well to your game!

- The time you're allowed to keep your crash combo streak alive has been drastically reduced from 7 seconds prior to this update to 4.5 seconds in this update!  Yes, it's a massive change, but with the counter now clearly visible, this time between combo crashes had to be reduced, or it was just far too easy.. and not challenging at all.

- At the end of each level, you'll be given all new "level difficulty" points based on the average speed of the vektoroids, the number of vektoroids, and the number of vektor fish you encountered.

- Points for collecting cake and milk have been heavily increased.

- Extra life rewards have been changed to 25k, 50k, 100k, 250k and then every 250k thereafter.  (Previously this was 10k, 25k, 50k, 100k and every 100k thereafter)

- You're now able to use the TAB key to change the game from full screen to windowed even while paused or in the welcome screen.

- Tabbing to switch between full screen and windowed now gives an audio sound to reflect the change

- The volume slider has been fixed to now work as intended.


While some might think changes this drastic to the scoring might mean a wipe of all the current high scores is needed, I believe that this new update will allow for even higher scores then ever before!  Time will tell.  ...Where can you place yourself on the high score list with a little practice?

I believe this this update is a solid update that should make FAN'CIE VEER! more enjoyable than ever before!  ..I hope you enjoy it as well!  Be sure and let me know in the comments below!


ZaxtorGameS    (Solo Indie Game Developer)

notes.title: UPDATE 1.06 - Much Greater & More Responsive Mobility! - Weee!
notes.notes:
It's been a long time since I've updated my 3rd Steam game "FAN'CIE VEER!" which launched way back in July of 2018.  Update 1.06 is definitely an update that will get you flying around much easier and with much more responsive controls than ever before!

- Much faster and more responsive controls than ever before!

- A new lightning style screen border will indicate that you have enough speed to crash through vektoroids (You still need to be the right color)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33100820/7079462fcf42a69c0e21c45290f2dcc4cece20b9.jpg[/img]

- Reflecting a bullet off of a vektoroid and into a fish will now net you 10 times the points as opposed to just shooting the fish directly!

* Remember that you use WASD to change your ships color and you want your internal color to be the same color as a vektoroid to shoot or crash through them with your ship..... and that you want your outer ship color to be the same as a vektor fish to shoot them!

- Eating is still vital as if you get too small you'll die and getting bigger means slower movement, but in this update, your size has a less significant impact on your movement speed than ever before.


Enjoy!  =)

- ZaxtorGameS

notes.title: UPDATE 1.05 - Cold Refreshing Milk Added To Wash Down That Chocolate Cake!!
notes.notes:
In update 1.05, I've added a nice tall glass of refreshing milk that will spawn any time you eat some chocolate cake.  Get it quickly as it doesn't stay on the screen long but it is worth DOUBLE the points of whatever the cake was worth if you can collect it in time!

Be careful because if you die before the milk spawns, or while it has spawned, the milk will disappear!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33100820/f91ddbbda1eafc461003778a52e5c06156d211c9.png[/img]

The glass of milk currently is randomly chosen to be either full, half full, or nearly empty when it spawns.

A Full glass of milk is worth double the points that the cake was worth.
A Half glass of milk is worth the same amount of points as the cake was worth.
A Near Empty glass of milk is worth half the points the cake was worth.

Who doesn't like some cold milk to wash down some delicious chocolate cake after all?   ..Enjoy!

notes.title: UPDATE 1.04 - Another BIG Update! Steam High Scores + Volume Slider + Sleek New Ship Design & More!
notes.notes:
More changes come to FAN'CIE VEER! in this update, designed to make this game easier to understand if you need to change ship colors before shooting to streaking through a Vektoroid and also encourage you to take more chances to get those crash combos!

THE BIGGEST CHANGE IN UPDATE 1.04:  
By far the biggest and most important change I've made in this update is a huge increase in both ship maneuverability and gameplay mechanics to try and make this game more fun and exciting to play!  Visual tweaks have been made as well, but I've always believed that gameplay is much more important than the cosmetic look of a game.  

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33100820/768da2d555d7a8038baa70cf1cc09b2bb8db235d.png[/img]

In the above image, yellow arrows point out that Steam high scores have now been added right into the game!  You have the top 1,000 high scores (if there ever is that many) for both HIGH SCORES and for HIGHEST CRASH COMBO STREAKS achieved available to see right from the opening screen!

You'll also see that a master volume slider has been added on the right side of the screen to help you control your overall volume.

And a new menu music has been found that I think fits a game with a name like "FAN'CIE VEER!" very nicely as well!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33100820/9011e1662fd924305f50d3aef87eeb373becee2d.png[/img]

As you can see by the above photo demonstration of the new ship design, changing your ship to the needed color to destroy both Vektoroids and Vektor fish is easier than ever now!

- Crashing your ship through Vektoroids has never been worth more points with this update!  Give it a try to see how many points you can rack up!

- You can now bounce your shots off of fish and your bullets will change to the fishes color.. and then if that shot hits a Vektoroid of the opposite color of that fish, you'll score HUGE points (about 10x normal points)

- Remember that going along with the above, you can also bounce your shots off of Vektorids and hit Vektor fish and if your shot color and the Vektor fish color match, you'll score big points as well (about 8x normal points)

- Both of the above ricochet shots will now alert you on screen on your amazing successful shots!

- Fixed an issue that could cause you to respawn your ship off of the screen if you hit the space bar while your cursor was off of the game screen.  This should no longer happen.

-  Made various other small tweaks and alterations to help improve both the overall feel and game experience while playing FAN'CIE VEER.

With the new shot ricochet system, the mechanics of the shots will likely take a little time to tweak and iron out better, but I believe the game is already more engaging and fun with my recent two updates and I hope you enjoy all of the changes I've made as well!  Please let me know in the forums or in the comments below!


Enjoy!   =)

notes.title: UPDATE 1.03 - Small Vektoroids Added, "Fat & Happy" Points + More!
notes.notes:
In this update, several changes were made...

* Smaller rocks (Vektoroids) were added and they are worth more points when shot and way more points when crashed through with your ship!

* Your bullets that bounce off of Vektor fish and Vektoroids because your bullet was not the correct color to destroy them will now KILL YOU if your own bullet hits your ship!  ..You'll also see the reason for death after you die state that you shot yourself.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33100820/e07a84869156686946aa89ac8bfaaadf1aef3100.png[/img]

* Added enhanced movement trail effects from your player ship that fades and narrows over time to create a more appealing look.  This new effect comes with no performance loss at all, and I believe only adds to the overall appeal of the game.

* Eating cake and being over 100% in size will now give you "Fat and Happy"points every second that you are alive and over 100% in size.  The bigger you are, the more points you'll score every single second!

* Added a Time Bonus counter with bars that show you how much time you have to score a time bonus by clearing a level as well as how many bonus points you'll score.  Seeing your time bonus points going down as time passed on each level seems to add an element of urgency to the game!

* Added smaller sized Vektoroids (rocks) that behave exactly as their larger kin.  You still need to be the opposite color to shoot or crash through them but they are worth more points!

* Adjusted the wrap around on the Vektoroids so that they will mostly disappear off one side of the screen completely before wrapping around to the other side  (Before you would see half of a Vektorid on each side of the screen as it wrapped around)

* Fixed an issue that would sometimes cause your bullets to not bounce off of Vektoroids when your bullet was the incorrect color to destroy it and instead your bullet would just vanish.  This has now been fixed and all incorrect colored bullets to destroy a Vektoroid will now bounce off properly.

* Fixed an issue that would sometimes cause your bullet to hang up on a Vektor fish and not bounce or vanish and also cause the Vektor fish to get stuck in position.

* Having time left when you clear a level has been increased to about 5x the previous rates to reward you better to clearing levels in fast times.  The faster you clear a level, the bigger the time bonus.


I think these changes are all solid and good changes that help make "FAN'CIE VEER!" both more fun and more rewarding to play!  ..But be sure and let me know your thoughts and especially if you come across any new bugs or problems caused by this update!

Happy cake eating and fish blasting!

notes.title: UPDATE 1.02 - Scoring Increased For Crash Combos, Cake, and More!
notes.notes:
The following changes were made to FAN'CIE VEER in update 1.02:

- Fixed a game breaking bug that would give you endless extra lives when you scored more than 100,000 points in a game 

- Your bullets will now bounce off of Vektor rocks and Vektor fish if they are the wrong color to destroy them.  The good thing here is that if they bounce off of a fish or rock because they are the wrong color and bounce off and hit a fish or rock that is the right color, whatever it hits will get destroyed.

You can now use the above ricocheting of your bullets off of asteroids that are not the opposite color of you and that are the same color as a Vektor fish to score 3x the normal points of just shooting a Vektor fish directly.  To give you an example.. if you see a blue Vektor fish and there is a red Vektor rock nearby, you could turn yourself blue and shoot the fish directly.  Let's say that fish would be worth 100 points if you just shot it directly... But now with this update if you instead ricochet your blue bullet off of that red Vektor rock and hit the blue fish with the bounce-off shot, you'd score about 300 points instead!  ..This can actually be fun and reward you with more points!

- Changed the opposite color assist diagram in the bottom right of the screen to now clearly show what keys (WASD) changes your ship to what color.

- You'll now be rewarded with an extra life for every 100k points after your first 100k points scored.  Previously, no extra lives could be earned after getting your first 100k points.

- Crashing through Vektor rocks scoring has increased significantly to better reward the player for taking the higher risk and speeds required to do so.  previously, you were awarded double the points of actually shooting a vektor rock, starting with this update, that has been increased to 5x the shooting-a-rock score.

- You also will be better rewarded for getting "crash combos" then before!  Smashing through Vektor rocks now also rewards you at about 350% the previous levels when you crash through multiple rocks in quick succession.

- The smash timer has been increased from 5 seconds to 7 seconds, allowing you more time to crash through a new rock in quick succession to help you build up your "smash combos"

- Eating cake makes you bigger and move slower, and now rewards you about 300% of previous point rewards before this update.

- You'll now properly be able to lose your ship size by moving.  To slim down, just keep thrusting with the right mouse button.  The faster you move, the faster your ship will lose size and gain speed mobility. 

- With the ships size reduction by simply moving, you can now die from starvation if your ship size drops to 20%.  Your size will change color at the top of the screen to RED if you drop to dangerous levels.  ..Eat cake to increase your size if your size drops too much!

These changes I believe better reward you for taking risks with the smasher aspect of this game and will also help players achieve higher scores on the high score list.  

I hope you enjoy the new changes made in this update!  ..Let me know in the comments below!  =)

notes.title: Angry Fish Revolt At My Door! .."CAP-FIG-CID" Gets A New Name and is Now "FAN'CIE VEER!"
notes.notes:
Last night after the weekend just after my "CAP-FIG-CID" game launched on Friday, I heard a wet and angry loud slapping at my front door.  My kids screamed in sheer terror at the strange non human sounds of aggression roaring beyond the wooden door that now shook in it's frame!  When I opened my door ready to protect my family and kids, I was unready for what was waiting floating in the darkness of the summer night air! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33100820/d211526f893bce3b8b4d83f6a39a7620b95cce16.png[/img]

These fish were not happy and had got the word that I had launched a new Steam game calling them "gross".  They were livid and demanding a public apology in a fish roar that barely made out understandable words.  Fearing my own life and envisioning seeing my poor kids being devoured in front of my own eyes, I dropped to my knees and apologized profusely. Tears filled my eyes and the horrifying floating fish roaring at me caused my body to tremble in horror.  

My apology wasn't enough...

The hours of the night passed and slowly the terror of the fish subsided as they became more friendly and less threatening.  They made me promise to never eat fish again and even forced me to toss out the eight cans of tuna they found in my pantry as well.  I agreed of course without any resistance.  

But as the morning hours came, I found myself laughing with the fish so loud as we sat at my kitchen table playing a hilarious round of Pictionary.  The fish were incredibly good at using their fins to work a pencil and at scribbling out pictures on paper.  The angry sounds were now deep laughs and the beer I had offered them did the trick and perhaps even saved my life!  Fish are so funny when they get buzzed or drunk on alcohol, let me tell you!

Somewhere in the night as the horror turned to drunken rounds of table top drawing games with the floating fish, we came to an agreement to simply not call the fish "gross" in this game.  To fish, that is the most vile and hurtful thing you can call them.  They said that they were totally fine with calling them nasty, especially after they saw how the fear they first filled me with caused me to wet my own jeans when I saw them at my front door.  In fact, that's what started their laughs and then me finding the opportunity to offer them some cold suds!  I guess you just never know when urinating yourself might save your life!  While they didn't agree that cake is delicious and tried to get me to change the cake in my game to "fingerlings", we finally came to an agreement that I could keep the cake in my game as well as long as I didn't call it "delicious".

-------------

In all seriousness, the name change came last night when I was reminded by a Steam friend that technically the part of my original title "Fish Is Gross" (Colors Are Pretty, Fish Is Gross, Cake Is Delicious) was not correct English grammar.  He stated that to be grammatically correct, it would need to be "Fish Are Gross" and well.. I wasn't about to change my "FIG" for Fish IS Gross to the initials for "Fish ARE Gross" for obvious reasons, mainly because I don't want to get kicked off the Steam platform as a small indie developer here!  :-D

So I decided to brainstorm a new name last night and come up with a name that better fit the nature of this game as it has developed and well.. here it is!  I definitely think the abbreviation "FAN'CIE VEER" is a much easier name to both say and remember than the previous "CAP-FIG-CID"!

I thought I'd share the reasoning for the name change and try and add a little humor in the process.  Hopefully I made one or two of you chuckle or at the least form an odd smile as you read this!

..Have a great day out there and if you did enjoy this little name change fish story, please share the link here on your social media and with your friends and family!  Small indie developers like myself can use all the attention we can get!  Please remember to remember the small guys out there whether you might be passing by a mom and pop drive-thru on your way to the national burger chain or whether you turn away the 12 year old boy asking to mow your lawn in favor of the big guys.  ..Small "fish" need love too!  :-)

Take care all!
